annotations.title: TIA — station from a prepared master copy

description: Requires app ≥ v1.8.0. Creates a new station from a device master copy in the open project's library (name from tia_library_mastercopies), returning {device: actualName}; TIA may rename the copy and its PLC. Known block-only content is refused with 409 mastercopy_not_device; unknown content goes to Openness. Clones an owner-prepared configuration, including PUT/GET, purchased-license selection and OPC UA interface mappings on the validated 1214C V4.4; it is not a setter for an existing CPU and does not grant license entitlement. Certificates are not copied: inspect the new OPC UA item, regenerate its server certificate if needed and compile before any human-gated download. Maps to POST /devices/frommastercopy {masterCopy}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.
